## Overview

This collected [[braintree]] setup-and-integration page is routed under Android v5, but its retained substantive body only states that the Payment Request API is available through Braintree's JavaScript v3 SDK and links that route. Its practical purpose is scope triage: use the separate JavaScript v3 guide for the documented integration rather than treating this page as an Android procedure.

## Key takeaways

- The Android v5 URL and slug do not establish Android Payment Request support. The captured page contains no native setup steps, request/result flow, SDK dependency, nonce handoff, server processing, or payment lifecycle.
- The `See also` section provides navigation to general testing, credit-card testing/go-live, and Google Pay testing/support material; those links do not add behavior to this snapshot.

> [!warning] Historical availability and evidence boundary
> This fetched 2026-09-16 availability notice does not prove current JavaScript or Android support, merchant or buyer eligibility, account enablement, exact SDK behavior, successful authorization, transaction creation, settlement, or funding.
